Are you a sushi lover looking for a great deal? Look no further than Kozou Sushi’s “Yokubari! Value Mori Fair”! This popular promotion features a generous serving of maguro (tuna) with 13 pieces for only 862 yen including tax.
To celebrate this special event, Kozou Sushi is holding a Follow & Retweet campaign where participants have a chance to win a 2000 yen meal voucher. Ten lucky winners will be selected through a random draw.
In addition to the delicious maguro value set, Kozou Sushi also offers a convenient mobile ordering option for customers to enjoy their favorite sushi dishes with ease.

With a focus on the popular #まぐろ, you can enjoy a generous 13-piece maguro value set for only 862 yen including tax. That’s a steal for all the delicious sushi you’ll be getting!
To make this event even more special, #小僧寿し is hosting a follow and repost campaign where lucky winners can receive a 2000 yen dining voucher . Imagine all the additional sushi you can enjoy with that prize! Don’t miss out on this opportunity to indulge in some premium sushi at a great price.
In addition to the amazing deals, #小僧寿し has also introduced #モバイルオーダー to make ordering your favorite dishes even more convenient. With just a few taps on your phone, you can have your sushi ready for pickup or delivery in no time. It’s the perfect way to satisfy your sushi cravings without any hassle.
For more information about this exciting event, be sure to check out the details at https://t.co/yU3cKR3EU7. You’ll find everything you need to know about the menu, promotions, and how to participate in the follow and repost campaign. Don’t forget to share the news with your friends and family so they can join in on the fun too!
So what are you waiting for? Head over to #小僧寿し and treat yourself to a delicious sushi feast during the ‘よくばり！バリュー盛フェア’. With great deals, tasty sushi, and the chance to win some amazing prizes, this event is a must-visit for all sushi enthusiasts.
